substats: Skill AMP + crit rate
why: The standard, and 서신우's weapon. Opponents stack crit RES and Moon Rabbit cuts crit. One accuracy line optional.

substats: Skill AMP + crit DMG (Chardonnay decks)
why: Disputed: with crit at 450–700%, some trade crit rate for crit DMG.

substats: Skill Haste + Skill AMP (Rye decks; 서신우's crit RES preset)
why: Three haste lines up top; 서신우 adds three below for six.

substats: Skill AMP + crit rate (Bari decks)
why: Zero haste: the fight ends before Milk heals.

substats: Crit RES + DR
why: Chardonnay pushes crit past 100% into higher tiers; crit RES pulls it back. 서신우 calls it essential.

substats: Skill Haste + crit RES (or DR)
why: Disputed: 서신우's crit RES preset keeps haste here; most Bari players drop it.

substats: DR + crit RES (or DR + HP)
why: Replaced Skill Haste here on Bari decks: the opening decides the fight.

substats: Skill Haste on all six right-side pieces
why: Disputed: 서신우's crit RES preset runs six, and one Bari player wins more on six than zero.

substats: Skill Haste lines: Bari decks 0, Rye decks 3–6, Peach evasion 3
why: Bari decks bet on the first hit; Rye runs six in mirrors, three against Bari.

substats: About 230% unbuffed crit on a Bari deck
why: So the dive still crits through Moon Rabbit's debuff.

substats: No accuracy or focus (at most one accuracy line)
why: Typical evasion is about 650, so accuracy is dead weight outside evasion matchups.

substats: A separate arena preset
why: PvP lines show little power, so the preset looks weaker than it is.

substats: Evasion preset: Skill AMP + crit ×3, focus + haste ×2, Skill AMP + haste; evasion + DR ×3, evasion + haste ×3
why: Evasion deck only: about 1,450 evasion took a ~20M deck to Grand Master 2. Loses to accuracy.

substats: Attack evasion defenders on the stage preset (accuracy)
why: Accuracy cancels evasion. Names are visible, so remember who runs it.

substats: Skip the Eternal Lv.95 lance, hat and cape
why: A paid set fixed at Lv.95 with set lines (the lance carries accuracy); weaker than Lv.100+ Eternals.

substats: Wear the arena preset, not the stage preset
why: Players who forgot kept losing to equal-power opponents.

substats: Skill Haste on all six right-side pieces
why: Disputed: one Rye guide cut to three lines; the same author's newer guide runs six.

substats: Rye decks: Skill Haste only top-right (3 lines)
why: One guide's template, as in Arena: bottom-right goes DR + crit RES.

substats: Bari decks: no Skill Haste
why: Most Oven–Bari decks run none, one poster says. Posters guess hasted chargers dive before the buffs land.

substats: DR + crit RES, with RES (저항) this season
why: RES resists Moon Rabbit's debuff; DR beats crit RES against her crit cut.

substats: Two accuracy lines, on attack or defense
why: Evasion defenses spread higher up; two lines bounce them.

substats: Evasion set (about 1,000–1,500 evasion)
why: Hidden names stop opponents remembering it. Accuracy beats it.

substats: Top rankers attack on their stage (accuracy) preset
why: Reportedly, to beat evasion defenders. An observation, not a guide.
